meta.title: How do we make earn-and-spend legible before scaling the rewards marketplace?
meta.hero_deck: Attendance and time-on-platform were falling while points piled up with nowhere to go. I ran a foundational study—problem frame, design-system stimulus, and moderated testing—to define one earn-and-spend story product could ship before marketplace UI scaled.

claims.statement: Clarify confusing dual-currency mental models so children know how to earn and spend rewards
Translate qualitative learner language into shippable marketplace and onboarding bets

resources.objective_notes: Understand how young learners think about marketplaces and points redemption. Develop possible marketplace names, currencies, and personal avatar designs.
resources.method_notes: Conducted in-depth interviews with 15 users, evenly distributed across grades 1–8 and US & IN geographies. Learners reviewed marketplace Figma prototypes with avatars, profile backgrounds, and class backgrounds.
resources.role_context: I owned the design research practice end to end: problem framing with product, Figma stimulus on the FutureSchool design system, moderated sessions with learners, and a readout that tied every insight to a shippable UI decision.
constraints: Attendance and time-on-platform fell while unredeemed points accumulated
Product planned marketplace and avatar UI without a validated earn-and-spend mental model
Dual currency (points and creator coins) with no plain-language ledger or next action
insights: Learners invented conversion rules because the product showed two currencies with no single balance story.
Creator coins felt random—children guessed at triggers instead of reading clear earn rules on screen.
Redemption intent was real; the marketplace surface did not show a obvious spend path from balance to hero.
Avatar picks followed power fantasy and aspiration, not abstract currency labels—design should frame heroes, not coins.
quotes: I think 1 coin = 2 points because coins are more precious than points
Points? nothing, i just have them, i dont know what to do with them
By doing good stuff, doing things correct - maybe I get creator coins?
I need points. I think I have enough points for Cyborg, Bolt & taz
recommendations: One ledger: a single spendable balance, plain-language labels, and visible spent history on the marketplace surface.
Onboarding at deploy: short earn and spend modules before learners enter the shop—not after confusion shows up in support.
Aspiration-first marketplace: hero grids and copy keyed to powers learners name, not parallel currency mechanics.
Staged ship order: ledger clarity and onboarding first, then depth (badges, avatars, level-ups) on a foundation engineering already reviewed in stimulus.
